--- first/README.md
+++ corrected/README.md
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@
 
 The ordered classifier maps the frozen G31 header predicates to a specific closed first category and stage while retaining the original generic reason. It stops before XML even when the header profile passes. Unchanged G31 is a differential test oracle, not the implementation of the classifier. Both primary and aggregate interpretations expose their own progress; the optional preliminary helper's exposure is separate.
 
-The aggregate pass checks every bounded directory entry once. Fully bounded raw central framing and zero central extra/comment declarations are prerequisites to name decoding; a failure preserves its category and leaves later families incomplete. Central predicates remain independently evaluable after a local failure. Local addresses come from declared central offsets, never an earlier failed size. Duplicate offsets, overlapping minimum declared spans and offsets outside the fixed-header range are rejected before local reads. A bounded fixed header may reveal a larger local-extra span causing a further overlap; its fixed-word read remains exposed, and variable-span/growth interpretation is then skipped. Every local span must be bounded and disjoint before variable bytes are interpreted. This is conservative diagnostic association, not format acceptance.
+The aggregate pass checks every bounded directory entry once. Fully bounded raw central framing and zero central extra/comment declarations are prerequisites to name decoding; a failure preserves its category and leaves later families incomplete. Central predicates remain independently evaluable after a local failure. Local addresses come from declared central offsets, never an earlier failed size. Duplicate offsets, overlapping minimum declared spans and offsets outside the fixed-header range are rejected before local reads. A bounded fixed header may reveal a larger local-extra span causing a further overlap; its fixed-word read and safe scalar comparisons remain exposed, and variable-span/growth interpretation is then skipped. A bad local signature also blocks variable interpretation. A wrong outer A220 identifier retains bounded outer framing comparisons but blocks payload fixed-word and padding interpretation. Every local span must be bounded and disjoint before variable bytes are interpreted. This is conservative diagnostic association, not format acceptance.
 
 Public families use the proposal status and dependency enums, with Boolean `checked` and `partial`; no per-entry record, identifier, member name, offset, raw size, bitmask, CRC, timestamp, exception text or fingerprint is emitted. Primary and aggregate local-extra counters measure software progress, never scientific examples. `diagnostic_complete` requires no unavailable family dependencies and successful cleanup; all outputs remain `BLOCKED_SCHEMA`, with `archive_accepted=false`, null scientific counts, zero fits and splits. Initial-padding semantics remain `UNBOUND`. No numeric outcomes, XML or payloads are interpreted.
